Subject: Quick ask — temporary credits for 48h geo-latency soak

Hi Stephanie,

Thanks again for the demo yesterday — the model performance looked promising. We need to run a focused geo-latency/throughput soak across our EU and US regions to validate tail latency under realistic traffic (synth load + small percentage of live traffic). The run is a 48-hour window, expected to generate ~1.2M tokens total (roughly 600k per region) with bursts up to 180 concurrent requests.

Is Redwood able to provide a short-term activation/bridge credit for the POC to cover this run? Ideally: a one-time provisional credit allocation and a 48-hour increase in concurrency quota. We can sign a short MOU or a mutual action plan; attached is our test plan (poc-run-plan.xlsx) with the traffic profile.

Procurement (cc’d: sourcing@edgescale.com) would like any gating items up-front (SOC2 checklist, IP/data flow, and a simple billing cap). We’re ready to run next week (preferred window: Mon 9/28 02:00 UTC for 48 hours).

Appreciate any quick guidance so we can lock the window.

Best,
Alice Zhou
Senior SRE, EdgeScale

- Procurement must confirm a billing cap of $2,500 for anything beyond the provisional allowance.
- EdgeScale agrees to run the workload in a controlled bucket and share the baseline prompt-set + representative latency traces for our QA team post-run.

Operational notes: Karthik — please stage the concurrency uplift and monitor tail latency during the window; Priyom — I’ll need the promo code/credit provisioning step (we can use a one-off credit code tied to deal DS-2026-0791).

If you all approve, I’ll send the MAP to EdgeScale and provision the credit once signed. Steph, please confirm we’re good to lock Mon 9/28 02:00 UTC (or propose alternate).
